fusions.name: Misdirected Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a strand that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 35% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Crossed Loyalties
fusions.desc: Snarls strands round every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage and stunning each for 1 second. Each hit has a 50% chance to turn the target against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Slipped Shadow
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, your movement speed rises 10%, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Loaded Dice
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
